about_1: The Story Makers was born from one conviction — every journey holds within it the seeds of a story profound enough to change how you see the world.
about_2: From the frozen highways of Spiti to the rice terraces of Bali, our handcrafted group expeditions bring together curious souls who return not just with photographs, but with chapters of a life fully lived.
hero_subtitle: Curated group expeditions across India & beyond — crafted for those who seek stories worth telling for a lifetime.

trips.name: Leh–Leh with Turtuk

itinerary.title: Arrive Leh — Acclimatize
itinerary.desc: Arrive at Leh airport, transfer to hotel. Rest and acclimatize. Evening walk to Leh market.

itinerary.title: Leh Local Sightseeing
itinerary.desc: Visit Shanti Stupa, Leh Palace, Hall of Fame museum and Leh market.

itinerary.title: Leh to Nubra Valley via Khardung La
itinerary.desc: Drive over Khardung La (18,380 ft). Visit Diskit Monastery and Hunder sand dunes.

itinerary.title: Nubra to Turtuk Village
itinerary.desc: Drive to Turtuk, the last village before Pakistan border. Explore apricot orchards and Balti culture.

itinerary.title: Nubra to Pangong Lake
itinerary.desc: Scenic drive to Pangong Lake via Shyok river. Arrive for sunset. Overnight in lakeside camps.

itinerary.title: Pangong Sunrise & Return to Leh
itinerary.desc: Wake early for Pangong sunrise. Drive back via Chang La pass. Evening souvenir shopping.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.desc: Morning transfer to Leh airport. Trip ends with memories for a lifetime.

trips.meetingPoint: Leh Airport, Kushok Bakula Rimpochee Airport

trips.name: Winter Spiti Expedition

itinerary.title: Shimla to Narkanda
itinerary.desc: Pick up from Shimla, drive through apple orchards to Narkanda.

itinerary.title: Narkanda to Sangla Valley
itinerary.desc: Drive through Kinnaur along Sutlej river. Arrive Sangla village.

itinerary.title: Sangla to Chitkul & Kaza
itinerary.desc: Visit Chitkul — last village before Indo-China border. Drive to Kaza.

itinerary.title: Kaza — Key & Kibber
itinerary.desc: Visit 1000-year-old Key Monastery and Kibber village. Walk frozen trails.

itinerary.title: Langza & Komic — Fossil Village
itinerary.desc: Drive to Langza for fossils and panoramic views, then Komic monastery.

itinerary.title: Pin Valley — Snow Leopard Territory
itinerary.desc: Full day in Pin Valley National Park. Guided nature walk.

itinerary.title: Kaza to Manali via Kunzum La
itinerary.desc: Drive over frozen Kunzum La pass into Lahaul Valley down to Manali.

itinerary.title: Manali Departure
itinerary.desc: Morning mall road shopping. Afternoon departure. Trip ends.

trips.meetingPoint: Shimla Bus Stand or Railway Station

itinerary.title: Arrive Bali — Seminyak
itinerary.desc: Arrive Ngurah Rai Airport. Check in to Seminyak hotel. Evening beach walk. Welcome dinner.

itinerary.title: Ubud — Art & Culture
itinerary.desc: Tegallalang rice terraces, Tirta Empul temple, Monkey Forest, Ubud Art Market.

itinerary.title: Ubud — Waterfalls & Cooking Class
itinerary.desc: Balinese cooking class, Tegenungan Waterfall, Goa Gajah Cave, Kecak fire dance.

itinerary.title: East Bali — Gates of Heaven
itinerary.desc: Pura Lempuyang temple, Candidasa black beach, Tirtagangga water palace.

itinerary.title: Uluwatu — Cliffs & Sunset
itinerary.desc: Uluwatu cliff temple, hidden beaches, sunset Kecak dance, Jimbaran Bay seafood dinner.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.desc: Morning shopping at Seminyak. Transfer to airport. Until next chapter!

itinerary.title: Arrive Srinagar — Dal Lake
itinerary.desc: Arrive Srinagar airport. Check in to houseboat on Dal Lake. Evening Shikara ride.

itinerary.title: Srinagar — Mughal Gardens
itinerary.desc: Visit Nishat Bagh, Shalimar Bagh and Chashme Shahi gardens. Evening at Lal Chowk.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg — Asia's Highest Gondola
itinerary.desc: Drive to Gulmarg. Take Gondola to Kongdoori. Snow activities in winter.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam — Valley of Shepherds
itinerary.desc: Drive through saffron fields. Visit Aru, Betaab Valley and Chandanwari.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam to Srinagar
itinerary.desc: Morning walk along Lidder river. Return to Srinagar. Shopping for Pashmina and saffron.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.desc: Transfer to Srinagar airport. Trip ends with Kashmir in your heart.

testimonials.quote: The Spiti trip wasn't just a holiday — it was the prologue to a completely different chapter of my life. Nothing has been the same since.
testimonials.name: Priya Mehta

testimonials.quote: Every detail was thought through. The hidden cafes, the midnight stargazing, the local family dinners — it felt like someone had read my soul and designed this just for me.
testimonials.name: Arjun Sharma

testimonials.quote: I've traveled with seven companies. The Story Makers is different. They don't sell a trip — they hand you a manuscript and say, Go live this. That's the difference.
testimonials.name: Shreya Nair
